People: Plutarch (author, Wikidata Q41523), died 200. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Plutarch, 46-120?") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's (Wikidata gives some of them several death years, every one 1925 or earlier: Plutarch [120, 125, 127, 200]).

Printed edition: Complete works, New York T.Y. Crowell, 1909, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/completeworks06plut. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 79%, 88%, 73% of their four-word runs in the scan's text.
